note: Mid-boss. Official: the reflecting shield (1504450, 3 s raise) after which Raur takes +20% damage buff / slams (1504460). The reflect itself is modelled as an HP pool: hitting through it throws the damage back at the party (CANDIDATE pool size and punish); waiting it out ends with the shield slam. Raised at 70% and 30% (CANDIDATE thresholds). Easy remaps 1504460 to 1504461.
